nodes.label: Modal backdrop target guard
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - fix-escape-and-backdrop-guards [ses_f174462aaffeDEmW17UJO7qkBC].md:L10497] Reused id: same claim, same house pattern (PomodoroThemeSelector). This note's own reason, which contradicts the brief it was handed: with onMouseDown plus the dialog body's stopPropagation intact, no press can reach these backdrops carrying a foreign target, so the brief's 'text selection that starts inside the body and ends on the backdrop' case would need a click handler to bite, not onMouseDown. nodes.label: happy-dom computes the propagation path from event.target, which makes a faked-target backdrop guard test vacuous
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - fix-escape-and-backdrop-guards [ses_f174462aaffeDEmW17UJO7qkBC].md:L10451] Reused id: same mechanism, rediscovered here by mutation. The first guard test was vacuous - removing both guards left it green - because happy-dom computes the propagation path from event.target, so a faked target inside the dialog body is stopped by the body's stopPropagation before the backdrop handler runs. Rewritten to mount a real extra child of the backdrop; removing the guards then fails exactly those two tests.

nodes.label: indexFunctions regex cannot index typed parameter lists
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - fix-escape-and-backdrop-guards [ses_f174462aaffeDEmW17UJO7qkBC].md:L10498] Reused id: same mechanism, worked out here for the new dismissWithCue helper. indexFunctions matches parameter lists with \([^)]*\), so a helper typed (onClose: () => void) is not indexed - the inner ) ends the parameter match early - and every call site of it was reported as an unaccounted silent control (WelcomeModal.tsx:42,58 and WhatsNewModal.tsx:36,52,92). Worked around with a type DismissFn = () => void alias; reported as a fourth blind spot alongside bare references, useCallback and cross-module cues.

nodes.label: The audio cue coverage contract is keyed on file:line, so a line-count change invalidates keys and has to be reported
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - fix-escape-and-backdrop-guards [ses_f174462aaffeDEmW17UJO7qkBC].md:L10483] Reused id: same constraint. Verified rather than assumed: no re-key was needed because every contract-keyed line stayed byte-identical (WelcomeModal.tsx:52, WhatsNewModal.tsx:46, EmbeddingSyncSection.tsx:292/299/311/318) and no line above a contract key moved. The dismissWithCue helper was placed below the component on purpose, because prettier refuses a one-line if (x) { a(); b(); } and that would have pushed the keyed line 52/46 down by 3. Every changed file's new line count is listed for the parent regardless.

nodes.label: A cue key must name the action the control performs, not the component it lives in
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-28 - fix-escape-and-backdrop-guards [ses_f174462aaffeDEmW17UJO7qkBC].md:L10470] CLOSE is played by both real dismiss paths in PomodoroThemeSelector itself (backdrop :97, header X :119), so the custom-theme editor's Cancel chip - whose whole body is setEditingCustom(false) and which leaves the modal open - must not ring it. Changed to BACK (back_001.ogg), which is this repo's established step-back-out-of-a-layer cue (PomodoroControls Reset Cycle/Reset Round, SubtaskList remove, OverlayHeader reset position, ChatInput stop generating); the commit-side exit already owns CONFIRMATION.

links.note: The guard is only exercisable in a test by mounting an extra child of the backdrop, which is exactly the workaround the happy-dom vacuity finding forced.

The dismissWithCue helper introduced to make the three dismiss paths ring identically became invisible to the cue-coverage detector because of this regex, and five call sites were reported as unaccounted silent controls.
Changing the Cancel chip key had to be verified against the same file:line-keyed audio contract as the rest of the edit.
The three coexisting schema generations are measured against REQUIRED_METADATA (title, type, para, status, created, updated, related); none of the three satisfies it.
Both are ways frontmatter related: escapes the link check: one because the parser returns empty for a block sequence, the other because the scanner never looks at frontmatter at all.
Listed together under tooling limitations that must be fixed before any lint result is trusted; together they make 0 active broken links meaningless.
Phase 0 discards the counts and Phase 1 fixes the resolver, in that order - the reconciliation is the gate the repair waits behind.
The MOC meta-text false positive is the specific failure of the content-based scoring; the audit is described as a keyword score over the first meaningful paragraph.
Both audit rows it rejects - the cluster MOC and tugas-etika-hukum-bisnis.md - are disagreement rows produced by the same keyword score.
